title: Aluminum Suppliers With No Minimum Order: Stated Policy vs Practical Floor
summary: Metals Depot, buymetal.com, and OnlineMetals all state no minimum order. The service centers do not publish one, which is not the same as not having one. What actually happens when you order one piece.
body_markdown:
### Which aluminum suppliers have no minimum order?


Metals Depot, buymetal.com, and OnlineMetals.com state no minimum order in the sources reviewed, and McMaster-Carr sells single catalog pieces. NOX METALS accepts single pieces but has an order minimum, shown in your quote. Alro, Clinton Aluminum, Speedy Metals, and Yarde Metals do not publish a minimum in the sources reviewed; confirm their current terms before ordering.


### Can I buy just one piece of aluminum plate?


Yes. NOX METALS accepts single pieces, and the current order minimum is shown in your quote. Other catalog sellers also offer single pieces. Compare the final total after any order minimum, minimum billed weight, cut fees, freight, and tax.


### What is a minimum billed weight?


A policy where the supplier bills your order as though it weighed a set minimum, even if your piece weighs less. It is the most common hidden floor in metal purchasing and it rarely appears in marketing copy. Ask about it directly before ordering a small cut off thick plate.


### Is it cheaper to buy a drop or remnant instead?


Usually, yes, if one exists in a size that fits your part. A remnant from a certified plate is still certified material. Our drop inventory prices identical certified material at roughly 20 to 40 percent below cut-to-size and ships immediately because no sawing is required.


### Can I get one piece of certified 7075 with mill certs?


Yes. NOX METALS accepts single pieces of certified 7075 with mill certs, heat numbers, and lot traceability. The current order minimum is shown in your quote; single-piece availability does not waive that charge. Compare the total delivered cost before ordering.
